title: Alone With the Horizon
text:
A surreal cinematic landscape featuring a single wooden chair placed alone in the middle of a massive endless green grass field under a soft pastel sky during late afternoon. A young man is sitting naturally on the chair, slightly turned toward the right side while looking far into the distant horizon. His face is partially visible from a side angle, showing a calm emotional expression.

The environment feels quiet, lonely, nostalgic, and dreamlike. The grass is highly detailed with soft natural wind movement and realistic texture stretching endlessly toward the horizon line. Wide open empty atmosphere with minimal composition.

The subject wears simple casual clothing in dark muted tones, blending naturally into the peaceful environment. His posture feels thoughtful and introspective, one hand resting casually while sitting relaxed on the chair.

Lighting is soft natural golden-hour daylight with subtle shadows across the grass. Sky contains soft clouds with pale blue and warm cream tones. Cinematic color grading with slightly desaturated natural colors, realistic contrast, soft highlights, and gentle film-like texture.

Shot in a wide-angle composition with the chair centered in the frame and the subject appearing small compared to the massive empty landscape, creating emotional isolation and visual depth.

Ultra realistic photography style, dreamy cinematic atmosphere, minimal aesthetic, emotional storytelling composition, shallow atmospheric haze, realistic grass texture, peaceful surrealism, 35mm film look, natural lighting, highly detailed environment, professional landscape photography --ar 9:16

Negative prompt: crowded background, city, buildings, cartoon, anime, CGI, extra chairs, fantasy creatures, unrealistic sky, overexposed lighting, cyberpunk colors, blurry subject, distorted anatomy, text, watermark
